`family-album-v1.xlsx` is the unmodified DIG4EL v1 Excel template, copied from
`templates/cq_spreadsheets/A family album_transcription_sheet.xlsx`.

`family-album-completed.xlsx` is a test-only copy with synthetic metadata and
values in Info B5:B10 and Transcription C3:E3, G3:H4. It exercises Unicode,
repeated-word labels, pivot and literal translations, and continuation notes.
These are test values, not contributed linguistic evidence.
